compare.title: Free camping or the state park?
compare.intro: Free camping here is on BLM land. There is no long-term permit area with water and a dump station, so the state park is the place with services. The Steps is Arizona State Trust Land, where you need a state recreational permit.
rows: Nothing to buy. Craggy Wash has a camp host
Reserve well ahead for winter. A dry overflow lot opens when the park is full
Craggy Wash, Lone Tree, Havasu Heights, Havasu Road, Standard Wash, Scenic View
699 London Bridge Rd, on the lake
compare.footer: Prices and rules belong to the BLM and Arizona State Parks and can change. BLM Lake Havasu Field Office: (928) 505-1200.
